1942-08-01.adjustments: At Voronezh the line read runs just west of the city centre (control points there are about 10 km off); it is moved east by fifteen pixels to the Voronezh river, which the Germans held. Where sheet Süd shows the line from the Don bend run west to the Chir and back, the line is taken straight from Kalach to the Chir. The tail crosses the Sea of Azov to the Kerch Strait so that the Taman peninsula and the Kuban stay on the Soviet side. Near Liski (then Svoboda) the line read crosses the town on the left bank of the Don; it is moved three to five pixels south-west onto the river.
